correctness.rationale: The supporting-side extreme-point identity V_4=sum_i min(2,K_i) is correct for iid boundary-arclength sampling. Multinomial occupancy gives h2=s4, h3=4(s3-s4), h4=6e2^2; Newton identities reconstruct e2>0 and e3, Vieta recovers unordered normalized sides. The cubic discriminant and signs e2,e3 plus f(1/2)>0 exactly enforce three positive real roots with all p_i<1/2, while Cauchy yields 3/8<h4<=2/3. The two distinct 61-denominator isosceles triples have equal s3, showing three samples insufficient. Independent rational occupancy checked three profiles and their exact h_j formulas.
residual_risks: Distinct root multiplicities are permitted; finite sampling noise and root-instability not addressed.
